Consider the following statements with regard to the setting up of the Backward Class Commission in India :
1. The First Backward Class Commission, set up by the Government of India, is popularly known as Kaka Kalelkar Commission.

flags: Statement 2 is printed 'The Third Backward Class Commission' — verified at 8x. The Mandal Commission was in fact the SECOND Backward Classes Commission, so the statement as printed is false; this reads as a deliberate distractor rather than a typesetting defect, and is transcribed as printed.
